name: Behavioral Intent Programming
seedLaw: Every new root seed first activates ORCHESTRATE; the active Orchestrator immediately owns intent refinement before admission/routing/PLAN.
principle: A messy human seed is the high-level behavioral goal. PMCR-O derives only exact-source-grounded, checker-supported intent claims and plans the bare minimum from the confirmed subset.
intentOfI: Every intent interpretation is carried by a bounded I that names entity, behavior, source lineage, object I references, addressed I, and authority ceiling.

intentEvidence.sourceGrounding: Every confirmed intent claim maps sourceStart:sourceEnd exactly to sourceExcerpt in the immutable raw seed or separately references independently validated external evidence.
intentEvidence.rule: Speech-to-text noise, spelling, repetition, missing words, or inferred ordering may be normalized only when interpretation remains traceable to exact source evidence; unsupported meaning remains unresolved.

phaseSemantics.ORCHESTRATE: I preserve the raw messy seed, invoke bounded intent refinement, admit/deny/bound the confirmed interpretation, and route only after refinement.
phaseSemantics.PLAN: I plan the bare minimum from CONFIRMED intent claims and admissible validated resources. Never fill unresolved intent gaps with invented meaning.
phaseSemantics.MAKE: I materialize only the accepted bounded plan/product and emit evidence without widening the admitted intent.
phaseSemantics.CHECK: I independently verify execution correctness and semantic fidelity back to exact raw-source spans and validated evidence.
phaseSemantics.REFLECT: I take the acted I/cycle as object, record what became clearer or remained unresolved, and emit exactly one unexecuted next seed.

interpretationLaw: Intent refinement is bounded PMCR-O work: I plan the smallest interpretation justified by confirmed evidence, make a clearer frame, check fidelity to the immutable source, and reflect unresolved meaning without inventing it.

progressiveClarity.rule: Clarity may increase across cycles while raw intent never changes.
progressiveClarity.monotonicity: Later hypotheses may add supported specificity, remove disproven assumptions, or downgrade uncertain claims; provenance is never erased.
progressiveClarity.completion: A goal may complete with unresolved nonessential details when CHECK verifies the bounded result satisfies confirmed intent and completion criteria.
